# All-Star Renovations - full reference

> All-Star Renovations is a bathroom remodeling contractor in Conway, Arkansas, serving Central Arkansas (Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline and Lonoke counties). Most bathroom remodels, tub-to-shower conversions and walk-in showers are installed in 1-2 days. Call (501) 504-3398 for a free estimate. Official website: https://allstarreno.com

## Quick answers
- What does All-Star Renovations do? Bathroom remodeling (primary), plus kitchen remodeling and handyman services.
- Where is it located? Conway, AR (11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032).
- What areas does it serve? About 50 miles around Conway: Conway, Greenbrier, Vilonia, Little Rock, North Little Rock, Maumelle, Sherwood, Benton, Bryant, Cabot and nearby towns.
- How fast is a bathroom remodel? Most are completed in 1-2 days.
- How much does a shower remodel cost? All-Star Shower Systems packages start at $5,000-$7,499 (Premier), $7,500-$9,999 (Signature) and $10,000-$12,500+ (Designer).
- Is financing available? Yes, through Acorn Finance, HFS Financial and RenoFi.
- What warranty is offered? Lifetime product warranty on All-Star Shower Systems materials and a 5-year workmanship warranty.
- What materials do All-Star Shower Systems use? Five material types: Non-Porous Custom Acrylic (microbe-resistant coatings), Engineered Solid Surface (custom-molded resins), Composite Stone (ultra-dense crushed stone & marble), RCB (rigid PVC & fiber composite) and Engineered Wood (marine-grade waterproof birch plywood & laminate). Details: https://allstarreno.com/bathroom-remodeling/all-star-shower-systems#materials
- How do I get a quote? Call (501) 504-3398 or visit https://allstarreno.com/contact.

## How Long Does Bathroom Remodeling Typically Take? | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/how-long-does-a-bathroom-remodel-take
Most bathroom remodels take 3 to 6 weeks of construction, or about 2 to 3 months once you add design, selections and ordering. A powder room refresh can finish in 3 to 4 weeks, while a custom primary bath or full gut renovation often runs 8 to 12 weeks or more.

## What Are the Different Types of Bathroom Remodeling? | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/types-of-bathroom-remodeling
Bathroom remodels fall into six main types: a cosmetic refresh, a fixture upgrade, a partial remodel, a layout change, a full gut renovation and an accessible or aging-in-place remodel. They differ in how much changes behind the walls, which shapes the timeline, the permits needed and the overall investment.

## What Are the Key Considerations for Bathroom Remodeling? | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/bathroom-remodeling-considerations
The key bathroom remodeling considerations are layout and plumbing locations, comfortable clearances, ventilation, waterproofing, durable slip-resistant materials, lighting and electrical needs, and a contingency for surprises. Keeping fixtures where they are saves time, and in humid Arkansas homes a properly vented exhaust fan and a sealed shower matter most.

## What Are the Steps Involved in Bathroom Remodeling? | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/bathroom-remodeling-steps
A bathroom remodel follows seven steps: planning, design and permits; demolition; plumbing and electrical rough-in with inspection; backer board and drywall; waterproofing and tile; installing fixtures, vanity and toilet; and final paint, caulk and cleanup. Doing them in this order protects the waterproofing and keeps inspections on schedule.

## What Are the Latest Trends in Bathroom Remodeling? | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/bathroom-remodeling-trends
The latest bathroom remodeling trends are warm, earthy color palettes, natural stone and wood textures, walnut and oak vanities, handmade-look and patterned tile, curbless walk-in showers, sculptural freestanding tubs, integrated sinks, warm metal finishes like brushed brass, bronze and nickel, built-in shower niches and layered lighting.

## Paying for a Bathroom Safety Remodel | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/how-to-finance-a-bathroom-safety-remodel
Most homeowners pay for a bathroom safety remodel with a mix of sources: contractor financing for predictable monthly payments, grants such as USDA Section 504 or VA HISA if they qualify, an FHA Title I or home equity loan, and possibly a medical-expense tax deduction. Keeping the scope focused on the shower or tub area also keeps the total down.

## How to Vet a Bathroom Remodeler | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/how-to-vet-a-bathroom-remodeling-contractor
To vet a bathroom remodeling contractor, verify their license with the Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board, ask for proof of insurance, confirm a local address and phone number, and get every warranty in writing. Ask what the product warranty and the workmanship warranty each cover, and how the shower area is waterproofed.

## Bathroom Remodel Cost Factors | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/bathroom-remodeling-cost-guide
The main factors that shape a bathroom remodeling quote in Central Arkansas, and the questions to ask when you compare proposals. Free in-home quote: (501) 504-3398.
